raw.query:
WITH checked AS (
  SELECT r.converter AS timing, d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_requests,
         d.gpu, d.is_current, d.superseded_by,
         s.completed_requests, s.num_requests, s.mean_ttft_ms,
         p.p99_ms, p.max_ms, p.n_requests,
         e.effective_mean_ttft_ms, e.effective_p99_ttft_ms,
         e.effective_max_ttft_ms, e.effective_build
  FROM provenance.v_dim d
  JOIN provenance.runs r USING (run_id)
  JOIN provenance.current_llm_summary s USING (run_id)
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p USING (run_id)
  JOIN provenance.llm_head2k_poly_aic_effective e
    ON e.srcbuild_run_id = d.run_id AND e.timing = r.converter
  WHERE d.is_current = true
    AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
    AND d.run_id IN ('srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src', 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src')
    AND p.is_current = true
    AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft'
)
SELECT timing, run_id, window_name, window_requests, gpu, is_current,
       superseded_by, completed_requests, num_requests, n_requests,
       mean_ttft_ms, p99_ms, max_ms,
       effective_mean_ttft_ms, effective_p99_ttft_ms,
       effective_max_ttft_ms, effective_build,
       count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY timing) AS per_timing_window_rows
FROM checked
ORDER BY timing
